review_summary: Almost no independent review footprint exists for LEF Rijopleiding: the only readable review text is two short owner-published testimonials on the school's own website, both praising instructor Margriet for patient, step-by-step coaching and good support for exam/test anxiety (faalangst). With zero verified or third-party reviews (no klantenvertellen, Trustpilot, Facebook, or Google review bodies), there is insufficient authentic evidence to judge the school from reviews; CBR data does show an above-average ~76-80% pass rate on a small exam volume.
